products.title: Topps Neon Marvel 2026 Hobby Box - Pre-Order
products.body_html:
Neon Marvel delivers a vibrant collecting experience driven by bold neon designs. It also expands across the many worlds of Marvel fandom, with gaming-inspired Marvel Snap and Marvel Rivals content, a Friendly Neighbourhood Spider-Man animation insert, and manga-inspired original art from creators Rose Besch and Leirix.

Rare inserts add another layer of collectability, with Marvel Murals spotlighting Tristan Eaton’s street-art-inspired portraits, Neon Tarots leaning into mystical character themes, Marquee Motion bringing comic art to life through lenticular technology, and Bella Rachlin’s Giant-Sized Booklet Autographs showcasing original artwork of some of Marvel’s most bigger-than-life characters.

Altogether, Marvel Neon offers a colourful, modern celebration of Marvel across comics, animation, gaming, art, and pop culture.

products.title: Topps Royalty Premier League EPL 2026 Hobby Box
products.body_html:
Created as a showcase for some of the most prestigious content in the Topps portfolio, Topps Royalty Premier League 2026 pairs regal-inspired design with low-numbered parallels, premium autographs, and an extensive selection of player-worn and match-worn memorabilia. Bringing together leading stars, emerging rookies, champions, and legendary names, the collection celebrates the players, performances, and achievements that have shaped the Premier League.

The collection opens with a 100-card Base Set featuring current players from across all 20 clubs, with every base card sequentially numbered to 60. A premium parallel structure runs from Royal Blue /25 through Red /15, Black /10, Green /5, Tyrian Purple /3, and Platinum 1/1, with one Base card and one parallel guaranteed in every box.

A deep autograph checklist forms one of the defining features of the release, spanning Royalty Autographs, Superior Signatures, Imperial Ink, Crowned Champions, Crown Duals, and a range of new concepts. King For A Day revisits great individual performances from Premier League history, Next In Line shines a spotlight on rookies, while the ultra-limited Bow To Greatness celebrates some of the competition's greatest-ever players. Landmark achievements are also recognised through A Royal Miracle, marking the 10th anniversary of Leicester City's famous 2015/16 title win, and 20 - Autograph Edition, featuring Liverpool players from their 2024/25 title-winning season.

Premium mem

products.title: Upper Deck Goodwin Champions 2026 Hobby Box
products.body_html:
The 100-card Goodwin Base set is chock-full of superstars of the past, present, and future! Search for top athletes, celebrities, and more!

Hunt for a wide variety of autograph, memorabilia, and low #-d parallels of the Base Set including the Red Rainbow, Green Pixels, and Golden Galaxy.

In addition to the Base Set, Collectors should hunt for Young Guns® ! This 50-subject set features the top Upper Deck Rookies and classic parallels such as Outburst, Clear Cut, UD Exclusives, and the always highly sought-after Gold Outburst!

The Goudey insert returns! With an all-new design and a checklist chock-full of top athletes and celebrities, these cards are sure to be a hit with collectors. Search for the all-new low-numbered Maroon and Light Blue and Black and Yellow Parallels!

Introducing the 2026 edition of Exquisite Collection! This set features an impressive array of rookies and vets. Collectors can find autograph and memorabilia cards, highlighted by the Rookie Auto Patch Gold Spectrum Parallel (#’d to 10)!

Look for a variety of iconic autograph sets, including Splash of Colour Autographs, Goudey Autographs, Goodwin Autographs, and more!

NEW! Traveling Circus Patches: This five-tiered manufactured relic set features a variety of circus performers, animals, oddities, and more! Be on the lookout for some of the creepiest cards around with the glow-in-the-dark Clown Masks that are sure to be a unique addition to any collection.

Fans will go wild for the original art cards that pay tribute to Superman’s history through the eyes of artists like Dan Jurgens and Brett Breeding. Fans will also be ecstatic for artist autographs and the 9-card Bizarro Variant set! The Man of Steel is back in action, ready to fight for truth and justice!

What’s waiting for fans and collectors alike:

  – Explore a nostalgic Base Set featuring all new original art inspired by the comics.
  – 1-of-1 parallels: Base Set Gold Spectrum, ‘95 Retro Black, and Black Medallions.
  – Thematic Inserts such as: Greatest Battles, Ultrabilities, and Man of Steel metal cards!
  – Artists autographs.
  – Original art sketch cards from artists like fred.ian!
  – Three 9-card puzzle sets by Nelson DeCastro celebrating the gold, silver, and bronze ages of Superman characters with a 27-piece back-of-card puzzle featuring stunning artwork by Nahuel Grego.
